content.short: Tangem is a simple cold Bitcoin wallet where you can buy, sell, and store Bitcoin, Ethereum, and other crypto assets.
content.description: Manage cryptocurrencies securely in the best crypto wallet. The Tangem cold wallet is fully non-custodial. No company, bank, or government can access, freeze, or restrict your assets. Only you hold the keys. The Tangem hardware wallet is powered by your phone's NFC module, removing the need for batteries and reducing the risk of hardware issues. It can function for decades under normal conditions. Tangem supports many blockchain networks.
content.meta: Find out about Tangem (WALLET) on the Cardano Blockchain, so you can make well-informed investment decisions.
